content: Offline boot with AdMob embedded: docs explicitly warn ads may be preloaded by the Mobile Ads SDK or mediation partner SDKs upon calling initialize - so initialize() must not run before onboarding completes and consent is gathered. delayAppMeasurementInit:true (Expo plugin prop) defers Google measurement init. initialize needs to be done only once ideally at app launch per Google, but is app-controlled - call it lazily. setRequestConfiguration (maxAdContentRating, childDirectedTreatment) must be set BEFORE initialize. UMP requestInfoUpdate requires network - gate behind onboarding; on consent errors still attempt ads using prior-session status. Embedding the SDK without initializing keeps boot network-free.
